visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with a dark beard and blue-tinted hair is seen in a medium close-up, wearing a black 'HOTDOCKING' t-shirt. He is speaking with an exaggeratedly confused expression, looking towards the right side of the frame. The background is a dimly lit indoor space with concrete-textured walls and a fire extinguisher mounted behind him. (2) A second man with curly black hair enters from the right, leaning close to the first man's face while smiling broadly. He is wearing a black sleeveless tank top with 'RROO' text. The bearded man reacts with a mix of confusion and discomfort as the curly-haired man touches his head and shoulder. (3) The bearded man pulls out a white plastic supplement bottle with a brown label depicting a muscular figure. He holds it up toward the camera, pointing at the label with a serious expression. Bright digital sparkles and yellow text overlays appear on the screen to highlight the product. (4) The curly-haired man takes the bottle and pours several white capsules into his palm. He puts them into his mouth and chews with an exaggeratedly happy and satisfied expression. Both men look at each other and the camera while smiling, emphasizing the completion of the interaction in the same indoor setting.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The video begins with two male voices engaged in a conversation with slurred, unclear articulation. A medium-tempo acoustic pop song with male vocals starts in the background. (2) A sharp 'thud' sound occurs as a supplement bottle is placed or handled. The vocal interaction remains highly animated and humorous, with rising pitch contours indicating confusion. (3) A 'pop' sound effect coincides with the opening of the plastic bottle. The background music continues at a steady volume while the men's speech clarity slightly improves as they transition to the promotional part of the skit. (4) The final phase features audible chewing sounds and satisfied vocalizations ('Mmm'), followed by a cheerful concluding remark and the music fading out over the last second.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Montage: Hook -> Misunderstanding -> Resolution -> Product Showcase
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To promote a Calcium + Vitamin D3 supplement through a humorous skit based on a linguistic misunderstanding. The video uses the concept of slurred speech to create a 'homophone' comedy where 'eating calcium' is mistaken for something else, eventually resolving the confusion by showing the actual product.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: The characters explicitly handle, name, and consume the supplement on camera, and text overlays provide the product name.
